title: 30 iterations pick the safe word
notes: After 30 iterations cat has 13 visits (mean 0.60), dog 11 (0.55) and fox 6 (0.25), so the move is cat. Dog hides the best sentence, the dog ran home (1.0), among three poor ones. The search has reached it 5 times, but dog's other 6 visits scored 0.1 or 0.2 and still hold its mean below cat's.
